statement: Under EPA's Worker Protection Standard, a restricted-entry interval is the period immediately after a pesticide application when entry into the treated area is restricted; when multiple pesticides are applied at the same time with different REIs, the longer REI must be followed.

review.rationale: Drafted from the reviewed EPA WPS REI source and cross-checked against the current EPA worker-protection page on September 15, 2026. The statement is limited to EPA's WPS REI definition and simultaneous-application rule and does not imply that quarantine or internal quality holds are the same legal control.
review.notes: Human pesticide-regulatory review is required before promotion.
